Meaning “steep hill”, Eype has been described as one of West Dorset’s most beautiful villages. It is easy to see why, as the village is full of pretty thatched cottages with country gardens, dating back to the 18th and 19th centuries. Situated just West of Bridport on the coast, Eype has a beautifully attractive sand and gravel beach, backed by Golden Cap, the highest cliff on the south coast at 191m above sea level.
